evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce Codoku (code sudoku), a renewable benchmark in which a solver fills typed cells in a partial program to satisfy global static and dynamic constraints, such as a prescribed control-flow graph and execution path.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Coding agents break two assumptions on which these benchmarks rest: an agent can recover the answer by executing the program instead of reasoning about it, and fixed task sets drawn from existing programs are increasingly exposed to contamination, yet costly to renew.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate five frontier models on 300 puzzles through a coding agent free to use any tool within a fixed budget.
